subject: PrivDeploy: platform fee credits, support elevation and starter discount matrix
messages:
From: Sara Lin <procure@osiristech.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alan Cho <alan.cho@osiristech.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP + request: platform fee amortization and migration credits for PrivDeploy

Hi Vivek,

Thanks for taking a look — attached is our RFP (high level). As we evaluate PrivDeploy (VPC/on-prem) options, procurement needs a short, itemized explanation of how Redwood expects customers to amortize the platform fee, and whether you can offer a node-migration credit for initial on‑prem installs.

Specifics we need for the SOW/finance team by next Wednesday:
- Line-item: one-time platform fee and suggested amortization term(s) (12/24/36 months)
- Typical support tier definitions and the delta to lift to 24x7 SRE support
- Any starter discounts for first 12 months, and whether they stack with migration credits
- A sample amortization CSV showing impact to CapEx vs OpEx for a 12-node starter deployment

We'd like to align commercial terms before our internal architecture review. Looping in Alan (CTO) for technical inputs.

Attachments: [Attachment: Osiris_RFP.pdf (PDF)]

Regards,
Sara Lin
Head of Procurement, OsirisTech
procure@osiristech.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lin <procure@osiristech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFP + request: platform fee amortization and migration credits for PrivDeploy

Sara — thanks for the RFP and the clear asks. Quick response with an initial commercial stance; Marissa will follow with the support matrix and a modeled amortization file.

High level (subject to final commit levels):
- Platform fee: one-time platform entitlement fee, list $350k for 12-node starter (we typically amortize over 24 months by default for public customers, 36 months optional for CAPEX-heavy buyers).
- Starter discount: for pilot customers we can offer a 20% starter discount off the platform fee for the first 12 months if a 12‑month commitment on support is agreed.
- Node migration credit: we can apply a one-time credit equal to the value of one node (pro-rated) if Osiris validates a migration window and logs (to cover migration engineering).
- Support uplift: Standard (business hours) / Premium (24x7) / Enterprise (24x7 + named SRE + 4hr SLA). Premium uplift typically +30% of annual support fee; Enterprise +55%.

Attachments: [Attachment: initial-pricing-sheet.xlsx (XLSX)]

Action items:
1) Marissa will send precise support slabs, SOW language and the amortization CSV by EOD tomorrow.
2) If the commercial shape works, we propose a working session Thurs 7/16 to run the numbers with your finance lead.

Looping you in, Marissa & Naomi — please include a sample amortization export and the support table we use for PrivDeploys.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
+1 415 555 0123

Thanks Vivek — that framing helps. A few clarifications before the Thursday call:
- Platform fee list $350k for 12-node makes sense as a starting point; can you show a 24-node and 48-node stepped schedule? Our finance model is sensitive to scale.
- For the migration credit: we need the credit explicitly called out in the MSA and an acceptance checklist for deliverables from your implementation team.
- Support uplift: can you show both dollar and percentage impacts to the annual run-rate? We often need both for executive approval.

Alan — are you good to join the call Thurs 7/16 10:30am PT?

On the CSV sample: please ensure it shows CapEx (platform fee net of credit), OpEx (annual support), and a 3-year amortization view with straight-line depreciation.

Regards,
Sara

Subject: PrivDeploy support slabs + amortization export (RDW-3421)

Hi Sara / Vivek,

Attached are the two deliverables I promised: a support slab matrix (PDF) and a sample amortization CSV for 12/24/36 month terms. Summary highlights below — pulled from the attachments for easy scanning.

Support slab (annual):
- Standard (business hours): base annual support = $45k (covers software updates + ticketing, 24hr response)
- Premium (24x7): base annual support = $58.5k (+30% uplift), response SLA 8 hours
- Enterprise (named SRE): base annual support = $69.75k (+55% uplift), 4hr response + quarterly runbooks + on-call rotation

Discount matrix (platform fee only):
- Pilot (12-month commit): 20% starter discount on platform fee
- Mid-commit (24-month): 12% discount on platform fee + option to amortize across 24 months for invoice smoothing
- Multi-site (48+ nodes / 36-month deal): 25% discount + 2 free migration credits (applied once during onboarding)

Migration credit mechanics:
- One migration credit = value equal to one node ($29k pro-rated for example shown)
- Credit applied against the platform fee on first invoice once migration acceptance form signed
- Documented in SOW: scope, runbook handover, log transfer confirmation, and success criteria

Attached files: [Attachment: support-slab-matrix.pdf (PDF)], [Attachment: privdeploy-amortization.csv (CSV)]

Next steps:
1) Vivek — if this commercial shape is acceptable, we'll prepare a term-sheet (DocuSign) capturing the selected discount and credit mechanics.
2) Sara/Alan — please confirm target commit (nodes + months) so we can lock exact numbers into the term sheet.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>

Sara / Alan — appreciate the quick turnaround and the detailed models. Summary of the agreed commercial path for internal alignment:
- Platform fee: $350k list for 12-node starter; Osiris to take the Pilot 12-month commit and accept the 20% starter discount, net platform fee = $280k.
- Migration credit: one node credit to be applied at invoice, documented in SOW.
- Support: Premium (24x7) selected; annual support = $58.5k; invoiced annually.
- Amortization: Osiris requested 36-month straight-line view for execs; we will display both 24/36 in the term sheet.

Action items:
- Legal: prepare term sheet (DocuSign) with RDW-3421 quoted, include explicit migration credit clause and acceptance checklist (Marissa will draft SOW appendix).
- Finance: Naomi, I'll need a final invoice schedule (first invoice = platform fee net of credit + first-year support).
- Ops: Marissa, please include runbook handover milestones in the SOW appendix and a 6-week implementation window.

Sara — can you confirm the call time Thursday 7/23 at 10:30am PT to run through the signed term sheet? If confirmed, we'll get Legal and Finance on the invite.

Thanks all — excited to move forward.

Best,
Vivek
